description: Export the followers and following lists of public GitHub accounts: one row per person with login, name, company, location, bio, profile URL, and user ID, plus a free report per list that says whether it was read to the end. No GitHub login. An optional buyer token reads faster with fewer fields.

github_token.description: Optional. Your own GitHub token reads through the REST API at up to 5,000 requests an hour, with login, user ID, and avatar only: no name, company, location, or bio. Never stored or logged.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_results_per_list.description: Rows to return per list, from 1 to 100000. Default 1000. Each row is charged. Large lists also need a longer run timeout: about 400 rows a minute.

users.description: Usernames or profile URLs of public GitHub accounts, up to 100 a run. Clay users: wrap a column in a one item list.

name: export_github_followers_following
title: Export GitHub followers and following
